audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 is given to Graves and Level 6 is given to Graves, yet both stage texts describe Darius winning ('every auto starts the Hemorrhage clock', 'Noxian Guillotine turns any 5-stack trade into a kill'); Level 2 is 'Skill'; and two-plus items is marked Darius while whys[6] and content.late both hand it to Graves.
audit.why: Graves top has no waveclear and must stand in Decimate range to land shells, so the early stages are Darius. His actual takeover is crit items: True Grit resists plus shotgun burst, exactly as the entry's own late text says.
audit.corrected: Darius / Darius / Darius / Darius / Darius / Darius / Graves in both layers.
sources: internal contradiction with whys[0], whys[6], content.late

audit.why: Spike ordering is right — Darius at 3 and 6, Graves on crit items. Only the chart ownership of those spikes was wrong, corrected above. Collateral Damage is 100/80/60s and Quickdraw 16s at rank 1, so his all-in window is genuinely narrow pre-items.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry calls Smoke Screen a blind twice — 'the blind neuters your autos' and 'his Smoke Screen blind'.
audit.why: Riot's text for Smoke Screen: it reduces sight range and slows on the initial impact. It does not blind. Believing your autos miss inside the cloud makes you stop auto-attacking during exactly the trade you win — the real problem is that you cannot see him to keep chasing.
audit.corrected: Described as a sight-range cloud plus slow on a 26-second rank-1 cooldown; keep attacking, do not chase blind.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing mentions that Graves's shot is blocked by units.
audit.why: New Destiny fires four bullets that cannot pass through units. Standing with a minion between you and Graves eats his whole shotgun blast — that is the single cheapest way to walk him down, and it is nowhere in the entry.

edits.before: Your AA + W chop wins most level-1 exchanges, and every auto starts the Hemorrhage clock. Trade on his last-hits but don't chase past the wave.
edits.after: Only Decimate is up, but his bullets cannot pass through units — keep a minion between you and trade on his last-hits. Every auto starts the bleed clock.

edits.before: You stay a side-lane terror but fall off vs grouped teams. Look for flank pulls in fights; one reset chain can win the game.
edits.after: Crit items and True Grit resists out-burst your all-in before you close. Flank from fog; one reset chain can still win the game.

edits.before: - Graves Quickdraw: matchup-defining — His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your engage/committal tool: never waste it on chip damage. - Your ultimate: the win condition — spend it on kill windows, not on waves.
edits.after: - Graves Quickdraw: matchup-defining — his dash and True Grit stacks, 16s at rank 1, shortened every time he lands an attack. Engage when it is down. - Smoke Screen cuts your sight, not your accuracy. - Your ultimate: spend it on kill windows, not on waves.

edits.before: R Noxian Guillotine punishes his squishy frame hard — at five Hemorrhage stacks he's dead well before the reset math even matters. Watch for Smoke Screen: the blind neuters your autos, so pull and W through it rather than trying to right-click him down inside the cloud.
edits.after: R Noxian Guillotine punishes his squishy frame hard — at five Hemorrhage stacks he's dead well before the reset math even matters. Smoke Screen is not a blind: it cuts your sight and slows, so keep attacking inside the cloud instead of backing out, and pull rather than chase what you cannot see.

edits.before: Your Stridebreaker spike still beats his — you're a juggernaut and he's a lane bully who falls off in extended fights. Force all-ins where his two-shell burst runs dry and your bleed keeps ticking; don't let him kite you with Quickdraw resets and E-to-wall dashes.
edits.after: Your Stridebreaker spike still beats his — you're a juggernaut and he's a lane bully who falls off in extended fights. His four bullets cannot pass through units, so fight with a minion between you and his shotgun runs dry; don't let him kite you with Quickdraw resets and E-to-wall dashes.

edits.before: E-bait his Quickdraw dash before committing
edits.after: Keep a minion blocking his shotgun shot

edits.before: Through level 6 you hold the advantage — E Apprehend into W slow into outer-Q heal beats his short window before Quickdraw comes back up. Ult him at five stacks and he simply doesn't have the health bar to survive it. Play around his Smoke Screen blind by pulling, not auto-chasing.
edits.after: Through level 6 you hold the advantage — E Apprehend into W slow into outer-Q heal beats his short window before Quickdraw comes back up. Ult him at five stacks and he simply doesn't have the health bar to survive it. Smoke Screen only cuts your sight and slows, so keep swinging inside it.

notes: Riot's derived flags tag End of the Line with 'terrain'; the description says it detonates on colliding with terrain, it does not create any, so I did not write a terrain interaction. Graves has no blind anywhere in his current kit — if 'Smoke Screen blind' appears in other entries it is the same error.
